name: heed
title: Heed
description: Move keyboard focus between windows and turn focus follows mouse on and off: Hyprland's movefocus and follow_mouse for macOS.
author: rbstp

commands.name: focus-next
commands.title: Focus Next Window
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the next visible window, screen by screen from left to right.

commands.name: focus-previous
commands.title: Focus Previous Window
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the previous visible window.

commands.name: focus-left
commands.title: Focus Window Left
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window to the left.

commands.name: focus-right
commands.title: Focus Window Right
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window to the right.

commands.name: focus-up
commands.title: Focus Window Above
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window above.

commands.name: focus-down
commands.title: Focus Window Below
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window below.

commands.name: focus-window
commands.title: Focus Window
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Every visible window by name, in Heed's spatial order. Pick one to focus it.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Focus Follows Mouse
commands.subtitle: Heed
commands.description: Turn Heed's pointer focus on or off.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
